candidates.unit: unclear (columns are Microlitter_count_water with VolWBodySamp [m3] and SampTrkLen [km]; the unit of the count column itself was not read)
candidates.rows_seen: unclear (zip holds a 83 MB ODV spreadsheet .txt of 28601 lines including about 100 comment/metadata lines)
candidates.licence: Mandatory citation of EMODnet Chemistry; no named licence printed
candidates.evidence: Downloaded the 1.4 MB zip, listed it, and read the header and first data row of EMODnet_floating_microlitter_2024_unrestricted_v2.txt (the zip also holds a binary ODV collection); the record page gave the DOI, 2011-06-14 to 2023-07-27 and the zip link.
candidates.why: A harmonised European sea-surface net-tow collection with per-tow mesh, mouth area, track length and volume; the DOI differs from the four 10.13120 DOIs already in dataset_candidates.csv (249f9080, 392b5190, 39fb84a5, 81526981), so it is not one of the 700 DataCite records.

candidates.name: Isobe et al. 2021 multilevel dataset of microplastic abundance in the world's upper ocean and the Laurentian Great Lakes (Levels 0-3)
candidates.evidence: Downloaded the zip and read the header and first rows of Level012R1.csv (8220 lines; the second line is a '-999: No data' note); Level3*.csv are 5-degree-style gridded files.
candidates.why: One row per pelagic sample with date, position and Level 0 to 2 concentrations; this is the Kyushu University compilation behind AOMI, which shares data with NCEI, so overlap is likely but I did not confirm it. The mesh or size window is in the paper's Table 1 (key 'No. in Table 1'), not in the CSV.

candidates.name: Marine Plastic Pollution in Waters around Australia: net tow data (Reisser et al. 2013)
candidates.unit: Cs in pieces/km2 (per the IMAS record; the CSV header carries no unit)
candidates.evidence: Read the header and first rows of nettows_info.csv, which uses CR line endings, and the figshare API for licence and file list; the unit comes from the IMAS record page, not the CSV.
candidates.why: Replicate manta tows with start and end coordinates, date, mesh 335 um and mouth size in one text field, and flow volume. This figshare DOI is not in dataset_candidates.csv, but the data may be in NOAA NCEI.

candidates.name: Collection 2: Plastic Debris in the North-west Marine Region, Australia (Reisser et al.)
candidates.evidence: Only the figshare API file list was read (1.DataTable.xlsx, 58582 bytes, plus two tif maps); I did not open the xlsx.
candidates.why: Companion nine-station Solander set to the Australia-wide collection, probably a subset of the same tows.

candidates.name: Monitoring microplastics in the Seine River in the Greater Paris area 2021-2022 (LimnoPlast)
candidates.unit: particles per m3 and ug per L (per the Frontiers data statement)
candidates.rows_seen: unclear (the article cites 5,922 individual particles from 7 sites over 4 campaigns)
candidates.evidence: The Zenodo API for record 10658366 returned licence cc-by-4.0 but an empty file list, so I read no file; unit and counts come from the Frontiers article data statement; the sibling DOI zenodo.10658365 is already in dataset_candidates.csv and may be the same upload under another version.
candidates.why: River survey with concentrations and fluxes plus particle-level records; code should resolve which Zenodo version holds the files.

candidates.name: Kiessling et al. 2021: floating macrolitter and meso-/microplastic at river sampling sites (Plastic Pirates, Germany)
candidates.unit: particles per m3 (FloatingMesoplasticsMicroplastics_m-3) and per hour of sampling
candidates.evidence: Opened the xlsx: sheets 'Metadata' and 'SamplingSites_and_LitterData'; read the field descriptions and first rows; the coordinates are described as approximate.
candidates.why: Citizen-science rivers survey with per-site meso/microplastic concentrations (ATR-FTIR confirmed); the size window is not stated in the file and the schoolchildren's net mesh would have to come from the paper.

candidates.name: Harms et al. 2020: microplastic particles (1-5 mm) in arable soils, Schleswig-Holstein (PANGAEA collection 924909, child 924908)
candidates.unit: particle counts per sampling unit with sample mass in g (a per-kg value must be computed)
candidates.evidence: Fetched the tab file header and counted lines; the 1-5 mm window is in the title; the collection 924909 is licensed CC-BY-4.0; no coordinate columns appear in this file's header (they may sit in the PANGAEA event metadata); none of 924898, 924903, 924908 or 924909 is in dataset_candidates.csv (0 matches).
candidates.why: 540 soil sampling units on 15 fields with counts and sample mass. The siblings 924898 (polymer identity per particle, 2653 data points) and 924903 (recovery experiment) are not concentration data.

candidates.name: SF Bay Microplastics Project: particle data for surface water, sediment, effluent, stormwater and fish (SFEI / California Ocean Protection Council)
candidates.unit: unclear (a 'Count' column; volume or mass is probably in other sheets)
candidates.evidence: Opened the xlsx: sheets 'Particle Data','manta','sed','eff','sw','fish'; the header strings shown are from the first sheet; latitude and longitude columns were not seen.
candidates.why: Multi-matrix, sample-level regional monitoring file (manta, sediment, treated effluent, stormwater); code must join the sheets to get a concentration and find coordinates via StationCode.
